details.label: Your unit
details.text: Three concrete walls, a canvas roof, privacy curtain and covered patio. Standard units have a double bed and twin bunks; two extra cots allow up to six guests. Lights and outlets are provided; there is no in-unit phone or TV.

details.label: Arrival & bedding
details.text: Check-in 4 pm; check-out 11 am. Bring bedding or rent it at camp. The front desk is staffed 24 hours during the operating season.

details.label: Services & access
details.text: Laundry is available to non-guests for a fee. Showers are for registered guests only; Curry Village has public showers for a fee. Shuttle stop 12 serves the camp.

details.label: Food & fire
details.text: Keep food, coolers, toiletries and trash in closed, latched bear lockers. Each unit has a grill and fire ring; wood fires are limited to 5–10 pm and remain subject to current restrictions.

details.label: Stay rules
details.text: Quiet hours 10 pm–6 am. Pets are prohibited except service animals. Sleeping in vehicles or outside units is prohibited.

details.label: Accessible units
details.text: Request an accessible unit when booking. The operator describes nearby parking, paved paths and accessible toilets; accessibility of a particular numbered unit has not been verified.

season: 2026 season · April 3–October 12; confirm operation before travel
